title: MAPES: Multi-Value Alignment Pipeline via Expert Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences requires simultaneously satisfying multiple, often competing values. Existing preference optimization methods collapse these into a single implicit signal, and even multi-objective extensions optimize within a shared parameter space, leaving cross-value conflicts unresolved. We propose MAPES, a multi-value alignment paradigm in which conflict resolution is a first-class concern at every pipeline stage: it first decomposes supervision into value-specific experts trained in isolated parameter subspaces, then recomposes them via preference-aware value merging and a lightweight harmonization stage that aligns the merged model with the expert ensemble. translated_title: MAPES：通过专家专业化实现的多价值对齐流水线
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐需要同时满足多个往往相互竞争的价值观。现有的偏好优化方法将这些价值观压缩为单一隐式信号，即使是多目标扩展方法也在共享参数空间内进行优化，未能解决跨价值观的冲突。我们提出MAPES，这是一种多价值对齐范式，将冲突解决作为流水线每个阶段的首要关注点：它首先将监督信号分解为在隔离参数子空间中训练的价值观专用专家，然后通过偏好感知的价值合并以及一个轻量级协调阶段（使合并后的模型与专家集成保持一致）将其重组。在五个偏好对齐基准测试中，MAPES在基准级别平均值上优于强大的直接偏好优化（DPO）变体和多目标基线方法，且在GSM8K和GPQA上没有出现大幅性能下降。
tldr: MAPES提出了一种多价值对齐新范式，通过将监督分解为隔离参数子空间中训练的价值观专用专家，再经偏好感知合并与轻量级协调重组，在流水线每个阶段将冲突解决作为首要关注点，从而在多个基准上超越DPO变体和多目标基线。
en_tdlr: MAPES introduces a multi-value alignment paradigm that treats conflict resolution as a first-class concern at every pipeline stage, by decomposing supervision into value-specific experts trained in isolated parameter subspaces and recomposing them via preference-aware merging and lightweight harmonization, outperforming DPO variants and multi-objective baselines.
